newsitem.title: CANADA: Rogers Cantel hit with lawsuit - report.
newsitem.headline: Rogers Cantel hit with lawsuit - report.

text.p: Rogers Cantel Mobile Communications Inc has been served with a C$46 million lawsuit by its retail dealers in a contract dispute, Canadian Press reported on Friday.
The news agency quoted Cantel spokeswoman Carleen Carroll as declining to release details, but confirming the cellular phone company was being sued.
Rogers Cantel could not be reached for comment.
A Hamilton, Ontario dealer, who asked not to be identified, told Canadian Press that the suit alleged unfair practices over a contract dispute.
No other details were immediately available.
Last September, Rogers Cantel said it was selling 21 of its 23 retail stores in Canada. Negotiations for the sale began later that month.
Some of the stores were to be bought by dealers and others by management groups, with some sold to outside buyers.
Cantel had said its dealers ran a more efficient operation and that selling the retail centers would let it focus on technology development.
